name: nemlig-shopping
description: Find Nemlig groceries, edit a temporary basket draft, and add its reviewed products to the Nemlig basket only when authorized.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me shop on Nemlig. Offer to find products, start a temporary basket draft, or load an exact saved shopping list as a read-only source. Draft edits stay local. Ask before adding the exact reviewed products to my Nemlig basket; do not open an unrelated list or submit on selection alone.
interface.longDescription: Find current Nemlig products and compare sizes and prices. Review chosen products in a temporary draft; edits do not change saved shopping lists or the real basket. Add exact reviewed products to the basket only after authorization. After verified addition, the app can optionally save the whole basket as a shopping list. No checkout or payment.
